{{Quote|I haven't felt you this tense since... since we fell into that nest of gundarks.|Obi-Wan Kenobi, to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
'''Gundarks''' were fearsome anthropoids from [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]] known as one of the most vicious, strong, and aggressive species in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. These non-sentient creatures stood between 1 and 2.5 meters tall, with four powerful arms and large ears as wide as their head. Both their hands and feet ended with opposable digits. Gundarks were covered in short brown or gray hair. Several animals such as the [[Aquatic gundark]] and the [[Long-necked gundark]] are named after the standard Gundarks due to their surliness or fierce nature.

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|Trust me, Anakin. You haven't suffered until you've eaten raw gundark.''"<br />"''You ''never'' ate raw gundark!''"<br />"''Are you calling me a liar?''"<br />"''Well&mdash;no, of course not, but&mdash;Obi-Wan, ''nobody'' eats raw gundark.''"<br />"''Not twice, at any rate. And it wasn't by choice the first time, I promise you.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Siege">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Gundark_TOR.png|thumb|left|150px|A gundark in the jungles of Dromund Kaas]]
Gundarks were birthed live with black coats of fur, and were able to fight almost from birth. A gundark's hair lightened as it grew older and its large, bat-themed ears began to enlarge until, at puberty, they reach the width of its head, hence the expression "strong enough to pull the ears off a gundark." These creatures were born with only two of its four adult arms, with the second pair emerging during adolescence.

There were several subspecies of gundark, including the [[Burskan gundark]] of [[Burska]] and an unidentified green subspecies with four equal sized arms, a tail ending in a pincher-like pair of claws, two toed feet, and a more reptilian appearance. Another sub-species was the [[Brachian Beastlord]] which was found on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Lamus]]. It was particularly vicious compared to main-line gundarks, and had a poisonous bite.<ref name="The Wellspring roleplaying adventure">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031218wellspring|text=The Wellspring|int=The Wellspring (roleplaying adventure)}}</ref>

In addition to true gundarks, other species of carnivores were called gundarks by a young scientist named [[Kin Kimdyara]], not because of physical resemblance but because of a similarly vicious, surly temperament. These species included the [[long-necked gundark]] of [[Kharzet III]] and the [[aquatic gundark]] of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].

==Behavior and intelligence==
{{Quote|I wanna get off this planet now. This place is crawling with gundarks!|[[Castas/Legends|Castas]], about the planet Vanqor|<ref name="R2 Come Home">{{TCW|R2 Come Home}}</ref>}}
[[File:Gundark-woswfg.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A gundark with young]]
Though not quite as intelligent as sentient creatures, gundarks were advanced enough to use simple tools such as rocks and clubs. (In spite of this, the expression "gundark brain" was used as an intelligence insult.) They lived in organized family units inside hollowed-out trees or caves. Several gundark families often lived together as a tribe, working for their common survival. Gundark society was matriarchal, with the oldest and most cunning female ruling the tribe. Males built the tribal homes and defended them ferociously from all intruders, attacking anything that entered the vicinity of the nest (and even some things that did not). Female gundarks were usually hunter-gatherers, acquiring the food needed by the tribe and training the young gundarks who weren't old enough to go out on their own.

Gundarks had intense sibling rivalries that sometimes ended in fatalities. Young gundarks usually set out on their own after five standard years with their clan, fighting their way into a new clan whom they would then call family. This practice helped the gundarks keep a great deal of genetic diversity. Gundarks usually hunted in groups when out for food or protecting the home. Male gundarks were particularly fierce while on the hunt, and female gundarks considered most sentient species to be their food.

===Combat===
[[File:Gundark_Vs_Hanadak.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A gundark (right) fighting a [[hanadak]] (left)]]
{{Quote|You look strong enough to pull the ears off a gundark.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|audio=EarsOffAGundark.flac|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
In gladiatorial arenas, a gundark was one of the most dangerous and feared opponents. The gundark's short temper and thirst for blood meant that it would attack without provocation. A battle-scarred gundark was frequently the favored creature in most arena matches, even against opponents such as [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]] or [[trompa]]. Because of a gundark's especially keen senses they were sometimes put into contests blinded or blindfolded to make the event "more sporting". Spectators would wait to see how long a less formidable creature could stay away from the gundark's lethal embrace. The fearsome and unpredictable nature of the four-armed beast encouraged trainers to handle it with extreme caution. Trainers would often use a [[Force pike/Legends|force pike]] to control their gundark, or else assign it a special guard detail. Gundarks were often kept sedated during transport. Due to the cost of gundark containment measures, trainers rarely had more than one in their pool of gladiators.

Gundarks normally fought with bare hands and relied on their enormous four-armed strength to overcome opponents, but were also capable of using simple blunt weapons such as clubs. Gundarks were strong enough to smash bones with their hands. In the wild, they often ambushed opponents, hiding until their prey was within close range and taking the victim by surprise. If unarmed, a gundark would often try to grapple its foe in an attempt to crush it to death.

==History==
{{Quote|I thought gundarks were only found on Vanqor!''"<br />"''Then this system must be Vanqor.|Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Dooku Captured">{{TCW|Dooku Captured}}</ref>}}
[[File:QuarrenvsGundark-EtU.png|thumb|right|200px|A [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] Big-Game Hunter faces a gundark.]]
By the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], gundarks predominated in the jungles of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] as one the species at the top of the food chain.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
Thereafter gundarks were found on many worlds throughout the galaxy, such as [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]],<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> and tended to live in temperate climates, though reports of arctic and desert gundarks were heard. The gundark homeworld was most possibly [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]], for that was the only planet they were found on during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Most gundark populations on other worlds were the offspring of escaped [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] or groups moved to new planets by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] agents attempting to protect them from slavery. Though it was illegal to capture or hunt gundarks on many planets the creatures were often captured and sold on the black market. Because of their reputation as fearless combatants, gundarks were placed in gladiatorial arenas, and were considered the ultimate prey by many big game [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]].

Between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the [[Colonist/Legends|colonization]] of [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] betwen [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]].</ref> gundarks were a persistent threat in the early stages of the [[Colonist/Legends|colonization]] of Alaris Prime. One of the first artificial structures built there, a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Power core/Legends|power core]], was destroyed by gundarks, driving off the Federation forces in that area. A group of four gundarks [[Attack on Attichitcuk's camp|attacked]] the first [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Attichitcuk's camp|settlement]] there, but were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by three of the [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonial]] leaders; [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[Shoran]] before they could inflict any serious damage. Another group of four gundarks later [[Attack on the Wookiee command center|attacked]] a [[Unidentified Wookiee command center|command center]] run by Chewbacca, who defeated them with the help of the command center's [[Turret/Legends|turret]]. Consistent gundark attacks caused both the Trade Federation and the Wookiees to independently plan to [[Skirmish at the gundark nest|exterminate]] the gundarks at their [[Unidentified gundark nest|nest]]. The resulting attack rendered the gundarks extinct on Alaris Prime.<ref name="GB" />

At some point prior to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] assignment of guarding [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] from an assassination attempt, Kenobi and Skywalker fell into a gundark's nest, with Kenobi noting that, until guarding the senator, this had been the most tense Skywalker had been, although Skywalker reminded Kenobi that he went in the nest to rescue his Master.<ref name="AOTC" />

Saying that someone "looked strong enough to pull the ears off a gundark" meant that they were healthy and unusually strong.

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
A [[video game]] called ''[[Gundark Trainer]]'' allowed players to train gundarks, but it was very violent. [[Roan Novachez]] enjoyed playing this game after forming a brief friendship with the bullies [[Cronah]] and [[Cyrus (Jedi Academy)|Cyrus]].<ref name="interview">[[Wookieepedia:Interview/Jeffrey Brown|Interview with Jeffrey Brown]]</ref><ref name="return">''[[Jedi Academy: Return of the Padawan]]''</ref>
{{Noncanonend}}

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'' claims that aquatic gundarks are true gundarks and identical to normal gundarks save for having four eyes. However, this contradicts previous sources such as ''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]'', as aquatic gundarks have multiple eyes, flippers, long tails, and no legs; furthermore, their bodies and heads are completely different.

The gundark sounds in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' were created from sounds of a horse and a parrot.<ref name="Drawing from the Present: Familiar Creatures in a Galaxy Far, Far Away">{{SW|url=news/drawing-from-the-present-familiar-creatures-in-a-galaxy-far-far-away|text=Drawing from the Present: Familiar Creatures in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|int=Back from the Drawing Board|nolive=1}}</ref>

The instruction booklet for the [[1993]] [[Wikipedia:Super Nintendo Entertainment System|Super Nintendo Entertainment System]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Super Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back]]'' spells the gundark, one of the player character's minor enemies, as "'''Gundarc'''."

Gundarks are identified in an entry on The Old Republic website's Holonet databank which features Aurebesh phrases such as "Sith Spawn," and "Dromund Kaas." In addition, it also had been labeled as "Jungle Skin Flayer" during the PAX walkthrough video for the game.<ref name="TVW">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20110312|text=Taral V Developer Walkthrough}}</ref>

In one of the earlier appearances of gundarks, in [[Star Wars (1977) 51|''Star Wars'' (1977) 51]], the gundarks are portrayed as large, orange, quadrupedal creatures with long tongues. Curiously, they don't appear to have ears, despite the mention of the creatures in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] specifically mentioning their ears.

In contrast, the designing crew for ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' went to great lengths to make sure the ears were visible on the creature.
